marta.s: Flagging missing SCIM deprovision audit rows for several EU tenants starting ~2024-07-02T11:12Z. Suspect correlation with yesterday's KMS RBAC tightening. Can we triage?

ben.d: I see the gap. Webhooks hit the queue but post-encrypt payloads are redacted. DB shows placeholders for `user_deactivated` events.

samir.r: Scanned KMS traces around the window: multiple AccessDenied/403 for alias resolution. Looks like the new policy filtered alias ARNs.

marta.s: Log snippet:
```
2024-07-02T11:11:58Z svc-scim-pipeline INFO received webhook id=wh_eu_42
2024-07-02T11:12:00Z svc-scim-pipeline ERROR kms:Encrypt AccessDenied alias/redwood-eu-archive
2024-07-02T11:12:00Z svc-scim-pipeline WARN audit_redacted id=wh_eu_42
```

elaine: That matches the RBAC change I pushed. I removed a broad alias pattern to tighten scope and probably missed older alias names.

oncall: security-bot created INC-2024-089 (sev=2). Paging oncall.

ben.d: Mitigation options: (1) revert KMS alias filter, (2) enable fallback to staging KMS key + encrypted S3 backstop and run backfill, (3) keep redact but export placeholder metadata. I prefer (1)+(2) to restore service and preserve raw payloads.

samir.r: Agree. Quick rollback restores normal alias resolution. For safety we must ensure the processor role still lacks Decrypt — only Encrypt/GenerateDataKey should be granted. I'll audit key policies pre/post change.

marta.s: Also found some webhook bodies with a debug param containing short-lived API tokens. Backfill must scrub or force rotation before archival.

elaine: I'm opening emergency approval for the policy revert. Link: https://internal/approvals/4567 :hourglass:

security-bot: Approval request issued.

oncall: Approvers notified.

ben.d: While we wait, can we flip the redact-on-fail behavior to backup-s3 mode? It's a config toggle and uses `arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/fallback-stage` which the pipeline can use now. That preserves payloads encrypted elsewhere.

samir.r: Do that but add a scrub hook to the backfill so we don't persist tokens. Also plan token rotation for any exposed creds.

marta.s: Adding compliance: we need an affected tenant list and a proof-of-backfill manifest for auditors.

elaine: Approval granted by @security-lead. Applying policy revert at 2024-07-02T11:24:10Z.

oncall: Policy revert applied. KMS alias resolve tested on retry.

ben.d: svc-scim-pipeline retried failed webhooks; encrypts now succeed and audit rows are returning. Backfill job started (id=bkfill-20240702-01).

marta.s: Backfill summary: processed 298 events, scrubbed 11 token values, rotated 4 short-lived tokens, uploaded encrypted archive to s3://redwood-sec/backfill/eu/2024-07-02/bkfill-20240702-01.enc (sha256 matched).

samir.r: Follow-ups: (a) add CI lint to prevent alias ARN regressions, (b) add alert if KMS alias lookup errors exceed 0.5% in 5m, (c) update runbook to include fallback-stage-key pattern and token-scrub step.

marta.s: I'll own the runbook and compliance memo. Ben and Samir, please create backlog tasks for (a) and (b) and tag P2.

ben.d: Creating PRs for CI lint and alerting.

elaine: Incident will be closed after compliance confirms receipt of the backfill manifest. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

security-bot: INC-2024-089 status -> monitoring
